title: agent-hub hook envelope v1
description: What agenthub-hook POSTs to the hub's /v1/events and writes to the spool. The hub ignores unknown fields; a missing `agent` means `claude-code`, a missing `event` means `payload.hook_event_name`.

agent.description: Adapter id from --agent, e.g. claude-code, codex.

event.description: Hook event name from --event (agent-native, e.g. Stop).

tsMs.description: Wall clock when the hook started, Unix epoch ms.

receivedAt.description: Same instant as tsMs, ISO 8601 UTC with milliseconds.

parentPid.description: First entry of processChain; absent when the chain is empty.

processChain.description: The hook's ancestors, nearest first, at most 8.

payload.description: The agent's hook stdin JSON (or `--json`) with content fields removed by the sidecar (prompt, question, assistant text; D-013); `{}` when empty or not an object. The hub reads a missing or null payload as `{}` and rejects any other non-object.
